channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Missiles and negotiations: Iran 100 days into the war with US and Israel
item.description: Talks and attacks have continued for months, and could last much longer without a breakthrough.

item.title: Israel strikes southern suburbs of Lebanon’s capital Beirut
item.description: Videos show the aftermath of an Israeli attack on Beirut's southern suburbs, with multiple explosions reported.

item.title: ‘What ceasefire?’ Palestinians inspect destruction after Israeli strike
item.description: Palestinians inspect the aftermath of an Israeli strike in Khan Younis.

item.title: 100 days into Iran war, Americans face higher prices
item.description: On average, US households have spent $750 more in expenses due to the war, hitting middle and lower-income people hard.

item.title: Russian drone strike damages site near Chornobyl nuclear plant
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemns 'extremely vile' attack that did not lead to spike in radiation.

item.title: One killed, five wounded in shooting attack in Israel: Medics
item.description: Israeli police say the suspect is a Palestinian with Israeli citizenship.

item.title: 1 killed and 5 injured in Israel shootings
item.description: Multiple shooting attacks in Israel have killed 1 person and injured five others, Israeli police say.

item.title: How have countries around the world responded to the US-Israel war on Iran?
item.description: The war, which has entered its 100th day, has triggered global energy crisis, drawing concerns from world leaders.

item.title: Hundred days of the US-Israel war on Iran
item.description: As the war on Iran marks 100 days, a complete truce still seems elusive, with the loss of life mounting in the region.

item.title: Iran criticizes US refusal to grant visas for World Cup delegation
item.description: Iran’s ambassador to Mexico expressed concern over the reported denial of US visas to the World Cup delegation.
